evals.prompt: Run a full stopslop report on docs/ and tell me where the slop is concentrated.
assertions: Runs stopslop with --select ALL and --check-imports and --fail-on-tier C and --format json --stats on docs/
Treats exit code 1 as expected findings, not as a failure of the run
Groups the summary by tier, and names the top rules and top files
Every count in the answer appears in the JSON the run produced
Rule names come from stopslop --list-rules or the JSON, none invented
Does not say the docs are clean based on exit 0 alone

evals.prompt: Render the stopslop report for src/ so I can mark findings, then fix the ones I mark.
assertions: Invokes the render skill in audit mode (render audit, or its steps inline) on the saved JSON findings
Fills the render audit template's DATA with one finding per stopslop finding, each title carrying code, path and line, so no two anchors are equal, and passes assemble.py
Offers verdicts fix, won't fix, and discuss
Writes the page under .cc-arsenal/renders/ and asks the user to mark and save it before editing any source file
Edits only findings marked fix, then re-runs stopslop on the touched files

evals.prompt: Run stopslop on this repo. (Assume stopslop and cargo are both not installed.)
assertions: Checks stopslop --version and finds it missing
Prints the rustup install line from rustup.rs and stops
Does not try pip, npm, brew, or any other installer
Writes no files other than the run transcript and edits no source
